name: Dungeons
rules_text: Venture into the dungeon: if you're not in a dungeon, choose one, put it into the command zone, and enter its first room. Otherwise, advance to the next room, choosing which arrow to follow at a fork -- never backwards. A room's ability triggers when you enter it. When the ability of the bottommost room has resolved, the dungeon is completed and removed; the next venture starts a fresh dungeon. You can be in only one dungeon at a time. Undercity is the exception on entry: you can't enter it unless an effect has you "venture into Undercity" (the initiative).
